help.desc: 30-day PS4Store service status, client download, install guides and fixes for common errors.
help.sub: Live service status, step-by-step guides and answers to the most common problems.
help.status.title: Service status
help.usb.title: Install PS4Store from a USB drive
help.usb.s1.d: Get the file from the card above or the home page, on your computer.
help.usb.s2.d: Format it as exFAT or FAT32, create a folder named "PS4Store" at its root and copy PS4Store.pkg into it.
help.usb.s3.d: With GoldHEN loaded, insert the drive into a USB port of the console.
help.usb.s4.d: Open Debug Settings → Package Installer, pick PS4Store.pkg and confirm.
help.usb.s5.d: The app appears in the main menu. It updates itself at the next launch.
help.pair.title: Pair your PS4 for remote installs
help.pair.s1.d: Use the Discord button at the top of the page to create or find your account.
help.pair.s2.d: In My account, click "Link a PS4": a 6-character code valid for 10 minutes is shown.
help.pair.s3.d: In the PS4Store app, open the pairing screen and type the code.
help.pair.s4.d: On each page, the remote download button adds the game to your PS4's queue, which installs it as soon as it syncs.
help.faq.title: Common errors
help.faq.a1: The host link may be dead or overloaded. Try again later and report the game on Discord (report channel) if it persists.
help.faq.a2: Free up space in Settings → Storage. Plan for about twice the game size during installation.
help.faq.q3: The game does not start after installing
help.faq.a3: Check the minimum firmware shown on the page and the game's region. Look at the compatibility votes and other members' comments.
help.faq.q4: Pairing fails or the code is rejected
help.faq.a4: The code expires after 10 minutes: generate a new one from My account. Also check that the console has Internet access.
help.faq.a5: The PS4 must be on with PS4Store open (or in active rest mode) to sync. Check that it shows Online in My account.
help.faq.q6: The website or API looks offline
help.faq.a6: Check the status cards above. If a service is unreachable, wait a few minutes, then tell the Staff on Discord.
help.contact: Still stuck? Open a ticket on the community Discord server.
